patches_added.name: Disable Content Capture
patches_added.description: Stops Chromium from streaming on-screen page text and URLs to the Android ContentCapture system service (Android System Intelligence).

patches_modified.name: Block Brave Telemetry
patches_modified.description: Blocks P3A product analytics, Brave Stats usage pings, crash dump uploads, WDP, Chromium UMA metrics, and Variations seed fetching.

patches_modified.name: Brave In-Product & Commercial Notification Optimizer
patches_modified.description: Eliminates background wakeups and notifications from Chromium tips scheduler (Job ID 105), Brave Rewards onboarding promo, and retention marketing campaigns.

patches_modified.name: Brave Origin
patches_modified.description: Unlocks Brave Origin and enables local feature toggle controls.

patches_modified.name: Brave Startup Performance Optimization
patches_modified.description: Optimizes startup time and eliminates background CPU/disk overhead by disabling unused OEM carrier partner customizations.

patches_modified.name: Clean New Tab Page
patches_modified.description: Removes sponsored wallpaper images, Brave News/Today feeds, marketing widgets, and promo cards from the New Tab Page.

patches_modified.name: Clean Share URL
patches_modified.description: Strips tracking parameters (utm_*, fbclid, gclid, igshid, si, msclkid) when sharing or copying links.

patches_modified.name: Disable Background Sync & Periodic Sync
patches_modified.description: Eliminates background wakeups, radio modem activity, and battery drain by forcing GooglePlayServicesChecker.shouldDisableBackgroundSync() -> true and neutralizing wakeup tasks.

patches_modified.name: Disable Battery Status API & OS Listener
patches_modified.description: Neutralizes the Battery Status API (navigator.getBattery) to prevent cross-site device fingerprinting and drops OS battery change broadcasts.

patches_modified.name: Disable Tab Auto-Minimization
patches_modified.description: Prevents Brave from minimizing active tabs to the background and forcing a New Tab Page when returning to the browser after inactivity.

patches_modified.name: Locale PAK Slimmer
patches_modified.description: Strips unselected language resource PAKs from assets/locales/.

patches_modified.name: Native Bloat Slimmer
patches_modified.description: Strips unused native companion binaries (Impress Vision AI, WireGuard VPN, and Android XR) to significantly reduce APK size.

patches_modified.name: Sensor Privacy Guard
patches_modified.description: Neutralizes motion, ambient, and orientation sensor providers to prevent hardware fingerprinting and tracking via Generic Sensor APIs.

patches_modified.name: Skip First Run
patches_modified.description: Skips the welcome screen, search engine selection, and onboarding First Run Experience (FRE) on clean installs.

patches_modified.name: Suppress In-App Promos & Surveys
patches_modified.description: Suppresses intrusive in-app rating surveys, Play Store review prompts, and marketing promo popups (YouTube promo, ad-free callouts, and Brave Ads onboarding).

patches_modified.name: Disable Play Services Integration
patches_modified.description: Makes Gboard's Google Play services availability check always report SERVICE_DISABLED, so GMS-backed code paths (Clearcut logging, Phenotype, account sync, Google Help feedback) are skipped at the source instead of being attempted. Note: Disables Gboard's inline Google Translate tool, which relies on Play Services Cronet.
patches_modified.previous_description: Makes Gboard's Google Play services availability check always report SERVICE_DISABLED, so GMS-backed code paths (Clearcut logging, Phenotype, account sync, Google Help feedback) are skipped at the source instead of being attempted.

patches_modified.name: Gboard Enhancements
patches_modified.description: Master customization suite bundling in-app toggleable features (AMOLED Pure Black theme, zero bottom inset, independent keyboard vibration, force incognito, voice typing in incognito, clipboard in incognito, clipboard retention, top toolbar icons count, cursor trackpad, and smart flags) managed directly from a top-level Morphe Patches category in Gboard Settings.
patches_modified.previous_description: Master customization suite bundling in-app toggleable features (AMOLED Pure Black theme, zero bottom inset, independent keyboard vibration, force incognito, voice typing in incognito, clipboard retention, top toolbar icons count, cursor trackpad, and smart flags) managed directly from a top-level Morphe Patches category in Gboard Settings.

patches_added.name: Skip Welcome Dialog
patches_added.description: Suppresses the first-launch About/privacy dialog by applying the app's own accept action silently. The About entry in the menu keeps working.

patches_added.name: Camera & Microphone Indicator
patches_added.description: Shows a corner mark while TikTok holds camera/mic open.

patches_added.name: Enable Live Search
patches_added.description: Shows TikTok's search entry in the Live drawer where supported.

patches_added.name: Feed Content Filter
patches_added.description: Hides stories, photo posts, and videos outside configured view or like ranges from feeds.

patches_added.name: Hide Suggested Accounts
patches_added.description: Removes suggested-account cards from profile headers and inbox surfaces.

patches_added.name: Non-Personalized Search
patches_added.description: Forces TikTok's non-personalized search mode instead of the saved account choice.

patches_added.name: Remember Clear Display
patches_added.description: Remembers TikTok's clear-display state between videos and re-applies it when new videos start.

patches_added.name: Show Author Region
patches_added.description: Displays the creator's country or region code next to their username in video author info across feeds and deep-linked detail views.

patches_added.name: Skip Content Warnings
patches_added.description: Bypasses and clears sensitive content warnings, graphic media blur overlays, and age gates on feed videos.

patches_added.name: Video Fit
patches_added.description: Adjusts video display aspect ratio across feeds and story cells: 'fit' ensures the entire video is visible without cropping, or 'fill' expands the video to fill the screen.

patches_added.name: Voice & Speech Engine De-bloat
patches_added.description: Strips on-device voice recognition and speech synthesis engines (libspeechspg.so, libspeechsdk.so) and their loader stubs (libspeechengine.so, libspeechepg.so) to save APK space. Breaks voice search (microphone button), voice input, and editor text-to-speech/sing features.

patches_modified.name: Clean Share URL
patches_modified.description: Strips tracking parameters, user IDs, device fingerprints, and marketing tokens from shared TikTok links, with optional custom host redirection.
patches_modified.previous_description: Strips tracking parameters, user IDs, device fingerprints, and marketing tokens from shared TikTok links.

patches_modified.name: Comment Customizer
patches_modified.description: Customizes TikTok's comment section, including native sort controls, clean text copying, disabling suggested emojis bar, hiding comment quick actions, hiding in-comment surveys and feedback cards, hiding profile photo story rings, enabling voice comments, automatic comment translation, fixing silent comment drops, and hiding comment popup ads.
patches_modified.previous_description: Customizes TikTok's comment section, including native sort controls, clean text copying, disabling suggested emojis bar, hiding comment quick actions, hiding in-comment surveys and feedback cards, hiding profile photo story rings, enabling voice comments, and automatic comment translation.

patches_modified.name: Device Privacy Guard
patches_modified.description: Neutralizes invasive runtime permissions, contacts queries, package inventory inspection, location hardware tracking, advertising ID profiling, background clipboard snooping routines, and motion sensor profiling to protect user data.
patches_modified.previous_description: Neutralizes invasive runtime permissions (contacts sync, location tracking, nearby devices), advertising ID profiling, background clipboard snooping routines, and motion sensor profiling to protect user data.

patches_modified.name: Direct Message Declutter
patches_modified.description: Removes visual clutter in direct messages and chat list, including the call button, reaction tray, message forward button, camera icons, input action buttons, try effect button, sticker reply suggestions, and the typing-triggered sticker strip.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes visual clutter in direct messages and chat list, including the call button, reaction tray, message forward button, camera icons, input action buttons, try effect button, and sticker reply suggestions.

patches_modified.name: Disable Double Tap to Like
patches_modified.description: Disables double tap like in the feed.
patches_modified.previous_description: Disables the double tap gesture to like videos in the feed, preventing accidental likes while scrolling or pausing. Videos can still be liked using the like button.

patches_modified.name: Disable Feed Long-Press Actions
patches_modified.description: Disables long-press action gestures on feed buttons, including Like to repost, Share to quick DMs, and Comment to quick emojis, with optional long-press video body redirection.
patches_modified.previous_description: Disables long-press action gestures on feed buttons, including Like to repost, Share to quick DMs, and Comment to quick emojis.

patches_modified.name: Feed Interface Declutter
patches_modified.description: Customizes and cleans feed video overlay elements, including the full screen button, repost pill, interest feedback pills, video descriptions, profile photo follow badges, story rings, playlist bottom bars, save buttons, and music discs.
patches_modified.previous_description: Customizes and cleans feed video overlay elements, including the full screen button, repost pill, video descriptions, profile photo follow badges, story rings, playlist bottom bars, save buttons, and music discs.

patches_modified.name: Live Stream SDK & Minigame De-bloat
patches_modified.description: Strips Live link mic SDK (liblink_mic_sdk.so), Lyrax RTC broadcasting engines (liblyrax.so), DM voice/video call engine (libvoip.so), live RTM messaging (librtmglobal.so) and live base runtime (libbase_live.so), plus live stream interactive minigames to reduce APK size and memory footprint. Breaks live viewing/broadcasting and direct message calls.
patches_modified.previous_description: Strips Live link mic SDK (liblink_mic_sdk.so), Lyrax RTC broadcasting engines (liblyrax.so), and live stream interactive minigames to reduce APK size and memory footprint.

patches_modified.name: Media Usability & Watermark-Free Downloader
patches_modified.description: Unblocks the download button on creator-restricted videos inside the Share panel, and routes downloads to clean unwatermarked media streams.

patches_modified.name: Playback Speed Persistence
patches_modified.description: Persists selected video playback speed across all feed videos and application restarts, and optionally enables the native hold-and-slide 2x speed lock gesture.
patches_modified.previous_description: Persists selected video playback speed across all feed videos and application restarts.

patches_modified.name: SIM Region Selector
patches_modified.description: Spoofs the detected SIM and network country ISO code, operator numeric codes, operator names, and cell identity MCC/MNC to bypass regional feed restrictions and catalog blocks.
patches_modified.previous_description: Spoofs the detected SIM and network country ISO code to bypass regional feed restrictions and catalog blocks.

patches_modified.name: Studio & Creation De-bloat
patches_modified.description: Strips heavy video creation plugins, CapCut NLE editor SDKs, effect plugins, camera dynamic features, upload video encoders, on-device AI runtimes (LiteRT), and AR camera face models to significantly reduce APK size.
patches_modified.previous_description: Strips heavy video creation plugins, CapCut NLE editor SDKs, effect plugins, and AR camera face models to significantly reduce APK size.

patches_modified.name: Video Quality Governor
patches_modified.description: Caps video playback resolution (1080p, 720p, 540p, 480p, 360p) to conserve battery, GPU/MediaCodec load, and mobile data. Download quality is controlled separately by the Media Usability patch (downloadQuality).
patches_modified.previous_description: Caps video playback and download resolutions (1080p, 720p, 540p, 480p, 360p) independently to conserve battery, GPU/MediaCodec load, and mobile data.

patches_modified.description: Adds "Copy media link" to the post menu: the direct links of the post's photos, videos and GIFs.

patches_modified.description: Saves downloaded photos and videos to a folder of your choice instead of Download/X.

patches_added.name: Crash reporter (debug)
patches_added.description: For debugging. After a keyboard crash, the error is saved and copied to your clipboard the next time the keyboard starts, so it can be pasted into a bug report. This replaces whatever was on the clipboard. Off by default.

patches_removed.name: Hidden Features (unconfirmed)
patches_removed.description: Turns on four finished Gboard features that a resigned build can never receive: Emoji Kitchen browse, the custom sticker tab, offline translation, and search in Gboard's settings. Off by default because none of the four has been seen working on a device — the flags flip, but some also need data Google only sends to an unpatched install. Safe to try: none of them crashes.

patches_modified.name: Swipe up to undo autocorrect
patches_modified.description: Swipe up on the keyboard to undo the last autocorrection: the word you typed comes back, as with Gboard's own undo autocorrect on backspace. It works right after the correction, before you type anything else; otherwise the swipe does nothing. The key you swiped on is not typed.
patches_modified.previous_description: Swipe up on the keyboard to undo the last autocorrection: the word you typed comes back, as with Gboard's own undo autocorrect on backspace. Gboard's decoder decides whether there is one to undo; if not, the swipe does nothing. The key you swiped on is not typed. Not yet confirmed on a device. While it is on, a keyboard crash is saved and copied to your clipboard the next time the keyboard starts, so it can be pasted into a bug report. Off by default.

patches_added.name: Crash reporter (debug)
patches_added.description: For debugging. After a keyboard crash, the error is saved and copied to your clipboard the next time the keyboard starts, so it can be pasted into a bug report. This replaces whatever was on the clipboard. Off by default.

patches_removed.name: Hidden Features (unconfirmed)
patches_removed.description: Turns on four finished Gboard features that a resigned build can never receive: Emoji Kitchen browse, the custom sticker tab, offline translation, and search in Gboard's settings. Off by default because none of the four has been seen working on a device — the flags flip, but some also need data Google only sends to an unpatched install. Safe to try: none of them crashes.
